messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: billing-metering.alert — token-count drift detected for prod-west (03:02-03:09 UTC). Impact: delayed usage emits, some overage flags triggered. Pager: paging oncall.
elsa_oncall: acked. I'm on it. Checking emitter & kafka lag now.
elsa_oncall: jia_sre can you confirm if any consumers are failing or if we have a backlog on broker metrics? @jia_sre
jia_sre: seeing consumer group `usage-ingest-prod` with 22m lag on partition 4, spikes around 03:00. No crashes, just slow consumption. CPU on ingest-worker-pool spiked at 02:58.
mike_billing: we're already getting inbound alerts from billing: a small subset of customers got provisional overage flags for last hour. Working with Lina to surface affected accounts.
lina_cs: heard from 2 customers via support — both small dev orgs. CS notified, queued messaging template: "we're investigating transient usage reporting delays; charges will be reviewed." Will hold until triage.
elsa_oncall: root cause hypothesis: transient consumer slowdown + queuing led to delayed emits -> late counts -> shadow aggregator replays caused short-term duplicate flags. Steps: 1) throttle retries on emitter; 2) scale ingest workers; 3) hold any automated overage emails. I'll run scale now.
deploy-bot: Scaling `ingest-worker-pool` from 12 -> 24 (requested by els a_oncall). Deployment rolling update started.
elsa_oncall: Mike, can you pause automated billing notifications and suppress overage emails for observed window? Need manual review before charging.
mike_billing: on it — toggled `billing.notify_overage` -> false for prod-west for 30m. Also throttling alert rule `overage-provisional` to avoid repeat noise.
elsa_oncall: Jia — tail logs for `ingest-worker-3` and search for repeated `OffsetOutOfRange` or GC stalls.
jia_sre: found repeated long GC pauses on ingest-worker-3 between 02:56-03:04: "[GC pause] 1.5s" x5. Rolling restart of that node.
elsa_oncall: good. Also starting a backfill job to reprocess any messages stuck in kafka window between 02:50-03:15. Will run at low priority to avoid compounding load.
omar_night: taking handoff in 30m. ETA to be oncall is 03:45 UTC. Els — please DM me the runbook pointer and any ongoing ops.
elsa_oncall: pinged you DM with notes + runbook. Current status: scaling in progress, one bad worker restarted, backfill queued, billing notifications suppressed. Customer impact: provisional overage flags for ~0.2% of accounts in prod-west. No confirmed billings yet.
lina_cs: drafting customer notice to affected users: short note + reassurance we won't charge without manual review. Will wait for final list.
mike_billing: preparing reconciliation job to compute corrected token counts after backfill. Will open a ticket to reverse any provisional flags if totals change.
elsa_oncall: timeline: alert @ 03:02 -> triage -> scale + restart @ 03:10 -> backfill queued @ 03:18. Expecting consumer lag to clear within 10-15m after scale. Monitor: kafka consumer lag, ingest worker CPU, billing event emit rate.
jia_sre: consumer lag decreased from 22m -> 4m after scale. GC pauses stopped on restarted node. Backfill job started @ 03:24 at low priority.
mike_billing: noticed duplicate provisional flags dedup key pattern: `customerID+window` — we will filter duplicates during reconciliation.
elsa_oncall: good. Omar — I'll hand off when backfill finishes or at 03:45 whichever first. If backfill not finished, continue to monitor and coordinate with billing for manual reconciliation.
omar_night: ack. I'll be on until 07:00 UTC. If anything spikes, page me directly and include `#billing-ops` and `incident-bot` context.
deploy-bot: backfill job `kafka-window-replay-1788765432` finished (duration 00:12:04). Re-emits: ~1.8M messages processed at low priority.
jia_sre: verification queries: aggregate token counts (03:00-03:10) now match pre-incident expectations within 0.1%. No persistent duplicates.
mike_billing: reconciliation run completed. 53 provisional overage flags rolled back; affected accounts will see corrected usage in next invoice cycle. No customer charges applied.
lina_cs: sending customer note now: "Issue resolved, counts reconciled, no charges applied. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a postmortem." :white_check_mark:
elsa_oncall: closing pager. Will file incident writeup and link to runbook fixes: increase JVM heap on ingest-worker image, add GC監視 alert, and add dedup watermark for provisional flags.
omar_night: thanks all. I'll watch overnight dashboards and follow up with PMs in morning. Good handoff.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: billing-metering.alert — token-count drift resolved. Incident severity: SEV3. Postmortem assigned to @elsa_oncall.
